blurb: GC Tours offers tours from Las Vegas to the Grand Canyon South Rim and West Rim, including VIP and helicopter tours. They focus on fewer stops to maximize time at the canyon and avoid delays. Lunch is arranged on many tours, with options to add or remove it.
extraNote: No surprise fees or fuel surcharges; price on booking confirmation is total price · Cancel for refund anytime up to 24 hours before tour start time
